analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -5.51% plunge pushed RSI to 30.7 in oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen at -2.8304. Positioned 16.6% above 52-week low of $520.26. ADX at 25.0 indicates early trend formation, but -DI at 38.4 is stronger than +DI at 15.2, suggesting downward pressure. Weekly RSI at 42.2 and weekly MACD histogram at -7.0200 show continued weakness. 4-hour RSI at 26.2 is in oversold. Quantitative buy attractiveness is 46/100, insufficient for a buy signal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
